top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a discovery in nature: the Bistritzer-MacDonald flat-band prediction at a magic angle, followed by the 2018 observation of correlated insulating and superconducting states, since reproduced by independent laboratories and extended to multilayers and moire TMDs. A citation limited to the prediction and the observed phases does not depend on the unsettled pairing mechanism, and the three-name allocation credits the joint 2011 theory and the lead experimental discovery, though experimental credit beyond Jarillo-Herrero is thin and precursor theory must be respected in the wording. P002 (Katori, Ye) is a mature, cleanly attributed invention and a close second; P000 is last because two sound, mature candidates are available.
recusal_note: No conflict with the P001 or P002 laureates documented in my profile; possible but undocumented link to Japanese academia (University of Tokyo fellowship, JSPS) relevant to Katori in P002, and I share Chalmers with Johansson.
